title: henckelia holttumii
intro: Henckelia holttumii, commonly known as the "Malabar Tooth-Ache Plant", is a species of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the relief of toothaches, fever, and other infections. The therapeutic actions of Henckelia holttumii include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
